lines.text: Every store has products that deserve more than size and color.
Meet Optionia. Product options for every store.
Add the options your customers ask for, and sell more of every product.
Engraving text. Gift messages. Print styles, delivery dates, even your customer's own artwork.
Sixteen option types, ready when you need them.
Style every option to match your brand. Colors, shapes, borders, or your own CSS.
Short on time? Pick a theme. One click, and you're done.
Charge for extras, and watch every choice add to the total.
Every custom order arrives with all its details, in one place.
Optionia. Available now on the Shopify App Store.
